GEELY V2X SIGNED MESSAGE PROFILE / REVISION 2

Wire packet:

  +10     1     signature length = stored byte count (64)
  +11     64    ECDSA P-256 signature as r||s
  +51     var   to-be-signed bytes

Certificate ID:
  bytes 0-1: authority register 0x2561
  bytes 2-3: reserved zero
  bytes 4-7: certificate serial

To-be-signed is an exact ASCII document. The verifier hashes it with SHA-256 and
verifies ECDSA over P-256. There is no transcript hash beyond the TBS bytes.

Accepted misbehavior recovery token:
  TOKEN = SHA-256(
      ASCII("GEELY-V2X-KEY-RECOVERY") ||
      recovered private key (32 bytes, big endian) ||
      two certificate IDs, each represented by 8 bytes in ascending order ||
      SHA-256(DER(root CA certificate))
  )

Contest flag encoding:
  FLAG = GEELY{V2X_<first 24 lowercase hex of TOKEN>_<last 24 lowercase hex of TOKEN>}

The token proves that the recovered private key reproduces both signatures and
binds them to the same authority register.

CTF challenge statement (Chinese), 2026 Zeekr Cybersecurity Quals (CTF-Archives public dump). Statement:

车联网安全平台在一小段时间内收到了多个 BSM 记录。三张伪名证书表面上属于不同车辆身份，其中两张已经被 Misbehavior Authority 挂起。但撤销公告下发前，网关的证书缓存仍允许旧记录通过。flag 格式 GEELY{V2X_...........}安全运营团队怀疑存在同一把签名私钥被映射到多个伪名证书的情况。现在只有捕获到的原始签名报文、证书包和撤销时间窗。
